title: Erdős Problem 111: bipartizing finite subgraphs of uncountably chromatic graphs
summary: A Lean proof that for every real C, a graph whose finite subgraphs on m vertices can each be made bipartite by deleting at most Cm edges has countable chromatic number. Hence h_G(n)/n → ∞ for every graph G that is not countably colorable, in particular for every graph of chromatic number ℵ₁. This answers the second question of Erdős Problem 111 in the affirmative.

review.reason: Lean formalization addressing an Erdős problem on bipartizing finite subgraphs and chromatic number.
